as.sfi_deduplication_instructions: Merge only candidates that represent the same source-backed SFI under the same curriculum scope. Class values Class IX and Class X should each merge within the document but remain distinct from each other. Content Domain values should merge only within their Class scope. Chapter values should merge only within their Class and Content Domain scope. NCERT Learning Outcome candidates with the same LO code and same source-visible statement may merge within the same Class, but Class IX LO# and Class X LO# must remain distinct. CLO# and C# codes are strong identity signals; keep same-code/different-content cases as review/conflict rather than silently merging. Never merge different statement_type values, and never merge a CLO with an Indicator even when text is similar.
as.sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract Academic Standards SFIs from the CBSE Learning Framework - Science source, focusing on standards-bearing content in Section 9, 'Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes and Indicators.' Extract Class IX/Class X headings, Content Domain groupings, Chapter groupings, NCERT Learning Outcome statements when an LO code and source-visible statement are present, Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes labeled CLO#, and Indicators labeled C#. Preserve English source wording. Preserve visible statement codes exactly when present. Treat the 'Key concepts' text in the left column as source context for the chapter, not as a standalone SFI. Do not extract front matter, foreword, preface, acknowledgements, process descriptions, Nature of Science narrative, content-domain summary tables, cognitive-level examples, pedagogical processes, assessment strategies, question paper design, sample assessment items, marking schemes, or reference documents as SFIs. Do not infer hierarchy or parentage in extraction; use only visible source text, table row/header evidence, and persisted provenance.
as.sfi_has_child_instructions: Resolve hasChild using the source hierarchy of Section 9. StandardsFramework root should parent Class nodes. Class should parent Content Domain nodes and NCERT Learning Outcome nodes. Content Domain should parent Chapter nodes. Chapter should parent the Content Domain Specific Learning Outcomes visible in that chapter's table rows. A Content Domain Specific Learning Outcome may also have the corresponding NCERT Learning Outcome from the same visible row as an additional direct parent when the source row explicitly maps that LO to the CLO. Indicators must be children of the source-visible CLO in the same table row or immediately continued row group. Do not create parent relationships from Key concepts text. Prefer same-row, same-table, same-window, same-source-context, and compatible canonical-scope evidence over broad nearby-heading evidence. Use StandardsFramework root fallback only when no supplied source-supported parent is available.

statement_type_policy.description: Use for the source-visible class-level headings that scope the standards tables, primarily Class IX and Class X.
Use for the source-visible science content-domain/theme groupings such as Materials, The World of the Living, Natural Phenomena, and Natural Resources.
Use for NCERT secondary-level learning outcome statements labeled LO1, LO2, etc. Extract only when the LO code and source-visible statement text are present.
